content.comment_body: Hello, We are currently using [article_no] [product_name] which, according to the manual, has a real-time clock accuracy of approximately ±2 seconds per day at 25°C. Is there an alternative item available that could provide real-time clock accuracy of ±0 seconds per day? The [article_no] Memory/Battery Card only extends the backup time and does not improve accuracy. Is this level of accuracy possible with [article_no] [product_name]?
The real-time clock shows the same deviation on [product_name] as before. However, the current version [version_no] can be synchronized with an NTP time server.

Thank you! What is the article or order number for this device? Can we use [product_name] [article_no] in conjunction with [product_name] [version_no] for configuring FS8? Is any extra hardware needed to enable integration or connectivity with an NTP server?

The article number you provided is correct. You can freely update to the latest [version_no] of [product_name] if you already own a full version. No extra hardware is required for using the NTP time server, but a stable internet connection is needed. There are special websites that list IP addresses for local NTP servers. For example, my home router also serves as an NTP time server.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are concerned about the accuracy of real-time clocks in certain [company_name] modules and are seeking options for higher precision, specifically ±0 seconds/day. There is a clear gap between current hardware capabilities and user demands. Discussion centers on NTP synchronization as a solution to improve timekeeping, but it is also clarified that such synchronization does not improve the inherent accuracy of the device's hardware RTC. Memory/battery cards only affect backup duration, not clock precision.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is seeking a [company_name] module with exceptionally accurate RTC (±0 seconds/day) or a method to upgrade/configure an existing system to achieve this level of precision.
